class.name: VideoStreamWebm
class.description: [VideoStream] resource handling the [url=https://www.webmproject.org/]WebM[/url] video format with [code].webm[/code] extension. WebM is currently decoded on the CPU, but decoding its video may be hardware-accelerated in the future. The supported video codec is VP9, and the supported audio codecs are Opus and Vorbis. WebM is more efficient than [VideoStreamTheora], but is more intensive to decode on the CPU. [b]Note:[/b] The VP8, AV1 and AV2 video codecs are not supported, and will result in a blank video. [b]Note:[/b] Unlike [VideoStreamTheora], an alpha channel (also known as transparency) is supported. This means WebM videos may contain transparent areas.
